We're delighted to welcome you to Bu-Dastoor Motors — another step in our efforts to integrate with global trends. Founded in 1981, Bu-Dastoor Motors is now one of the fastest-growing and most successful companies, leading the way in Kuwait through consistent technological advancements, research, and development.

The group is managed by a selective team of professionals, always up-to-date in their areas of expertise — from car sales to the most advanced services. Over the years, we've consistently strived to achieve excellence through professional management, customer focus, long-term partner relationships, employee well-being, and above all, the best work ethics and moral values.
